items.t: heise+ | Von Gehirnscan zu Bild: Wie KI rekonstruiert, was Menschen gerade sehen

items.t: Southeast Asia’s digital economy to hit $368 billion
items.s: Widespread AI adoption is propelling Southeast Asia's digital economy to a projected $368 billion in 2026 and $1 trillion by 2035.

items.t: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
items.s: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

items.t: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
items.s: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.
